ModMetadata.Name: Better Code Editor [StationeersLaunchPad]
ModMetadata.Author: vinus
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Better Code Editor[/h1] [b]WARNING:[/b] This is a StationeersLaunchPad Plugin Mod. It requires Bepinex to be installed with the StationeersLaunchPad plugin. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
This mod adds extra lines of code and increases the max length of the lines ([i]or even decrease[/i]) You can change these settings using the config.
you can also go here to get the dll itself if you want to just put it in your bepinex/plugins folder: https://github.com/TerameTechYT/StationeersSharp/releases/latest
ModMetadata.ChangeLog: - change platform to x64 - change workflow upload-artfact to v4 - push directory config - test workflow
